integrity: Original self-contained critical omega-limit selection and compact stationary-state classification with reproducible symbolic algebra. General third-order weighted-feedback and forced-jerk period identities are prior and acknowledged, not independent novelty claims.
scientific_limitations: Classification of critical omega-limits requires bounded forward trajectories at A=±1 and does not imply phase convergence or attraction from all initial data. Compact invariant measures are classified for |A|>=1, not the open interval. The 2000 no-chaos article was available only by abstract; no independent audit was performed.
title: Exact critical omega-limit selection and recurrence simplex in the Linz–Sprott modulus jerk
